_about: Button, help and ending text for the scenes (T-27). Collected from the v0.7 app.js (commit faf9ea5) and adapted for the desktop build: 'trial' became 'run', save slots became one save. Names and descriptions of souls, destinations, memories and quests are not copied here; scenes read them from Ferry.data (rules/content.json). Words in {braces} are filled in by t(key, values).

title.heading: The Ferryman
title.tagline: Carry souls to their wishes. Face the five Polongs. Follow eight stories along the river.
title.brokenSave: The saved run cannot be read. Start a new game to replace it.
title.seedHint: Click the seed, type digits, press Enter. Leave it on random for a normal game.
title.seedInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4294967295.
title.replaceBody: Starting a new game deletes the saved run. This cannot be undone.
title.storageUnavailable: Saving is unavailable on this computer. This run will not be kept.
title.storageFailed: Saving failed. This run may not be kept.

boarding.heading: Who will you carry?
boarding.intro: Choose passengers within capacity. Quest attempts begin when the required characters depart together.
boarding.nextPolong: Next Polong: {name} · encounter {encounter}. It boards on the next scheduled third outward round unless Moly is active.
boarding.heroHeracles: One seat. Choose a shore soul as Hades' toll and lose 1 Light. The toll grants no memory.
boarding.heroOdysseus: One seat. Reach his wish to meet Tiresias and choose a route through danger.
boarding.boatSpace: Use Boat Space (+1 seat this trip)
boarding.clash: Merchant cannot depart with both Blacksmith and Mason.

crossing.prepIntro: Use held memories as needed, then continue. Each copy is consumed; there is no use cap.
crossing.overLimit: Excess rewards cannot be played. Finish this round and choose what to keep.
crossing.purifyTitle: Reset one passenger's Anger to zero
crossing.noMemories: No memories held. Deliver passengers and complete quests to earn them.
crossing.routeIntro: The round has begun and any scheduled Polong is aboard. Confirm one route to cross.
crossing.concealedDetail: Po Mued conceals this destination. Confirm to reveal it and pay its fog.
crossing.reviewIntro: Back returns to the same fork without rerolling it.
crossing.concealedWarning: The destination and its fog remain hidden until you confirm. This may put out the lantern.
crossing.lethal: Zero Light ends the run before delivery.

delivery.heading: Who disembarks at {place}?
delivery.intro: Choose eligible passengers. Those who remain face pair effects, Anger and Wraith expiry.
delivery.emptyBoat: The encounter has left the boat empty. Finish resolving this round.

return.heading: Return to the Starting Shore
return.cost: {loss} Light from waiting souls expiring, then +1 Light if alive.
return.expire: Boat Space, Moly and Nobody expire on this return.
return.lethal: The lantern goes out before healing.

choice.odysseusIntro: Odysseus has disembarked. Choose how to continue; the random consequence is committed once when selected.
choice.charybdisCost: Lose one random held memory, if any.
choice.charybdisReward: Receive Moly of Hermes: suppress future Polong arrivals until the next return when played.
choice.zillaCost: One random ordinary passenger becomes a Wraith: lose 1 Light. No eligible passenger means no loss.
choice.zillaReward: If alive, receive Nobody: prevent fog until the next return when played.
choice.theftIntro: Choose one held memory to lose. This choice is saved until you resolve it.

trim.heading: Keep up to {limit} memories
trim.intro: Choose excess memories to discard. They cannot be used instead.

gameOver.heading: The river remembers
gameOver.summary: {cycles} cycles survived · {deliveries} ordinary souls delivered · {quests} quests completed

journal.heading: Passengers and quests
journal.noQuests: Pair the required characters on one departure to start an ordinary quest. Heroes have separate encounters.

help.heading: How to play
help.pendingIntro: These characters belong to the roster. They become playable once their wishes, memories and abilities are defined.
